text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here we are at the Hanshin<n>Racecourse today for
the spring<n>Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Which one of these fine competitors<n>will walk away
with the coveted<n>spring shield? Narita Taishin and
Biwa<n>Hayahide, of the BNW trio, are the<n>two to
watch out for today!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
According to the report released<n>yesterday, the turf
should have just<n>the right bounce today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And these weather conditions are<n>similar to when I
ran the D course last<n>week.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
All you need to do is sit back and<n>watch my winning
equation in action!
